$comment: Describes every setting in config.jsonc for a settings app. Keys match config.jsonc paths. Keep in sync: python3 tools/check-config.py

types.number: Decimal number. Uses min / max / step / unit.
types.integer: Whole number. Uses min / max / step / unit.
types.string: Free text. With "choices": one of the listed values.
types.icon: File name of an SVG in assets/icons.
types.iconList: List of icon file names; "length" is the expected count.
types.object: Free-form object of overrides; edit as JSON.
types.actionList: List of launcher actions: { title, subtitle, keywords (space separated), icon (file in assets/icons), command (list: program then arguments), confirm (true = press Enter twice) }.
types.command: A command: list of program then arguments. {path} is replaced by the file path, {uri} by its file:// address.
types.integerList: List of whole numbers. Uses min / max / unit for each value.
types.handwriting: File name of an SVG in assets/handwriting: stroked <path> elements and a viewBox, drawn in order.
types.fontFile: File name of a font in assets/fonts, or "" for none.
types.menuList: List of menu rows: { title, icon (file in assets/icons), and either command (list: program then arguments; {id} = the focused window's niri id, ~ = home) or open (what to open: a dropdown's name, "notifications", "media") }; optional: confirm (true = click twice), danger (true = red), separator (true = a line above it). A row may follow the focused window's state: state ("floating", "maximized" or "fullscreen") with onTitle / onIcon, shown while that state is on (Float becomes Tile).

springFields.label: Response
springFields.description: How long the spring takes to settle, roughly.

springFields.label: Damping
springFields.description: Below 1 it bounces (lower = more bounce); 1 settles without bouncing.

springFields.label: Starting scale
springFields.description: Size the content starts from before it springs to full size.

sections.title: Appearance
sections.description: Fonts and colors used everywhere.

groups.title: Font
groups.description: Text style for the whole shell.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: The font used for all text. Allo ships with the shell (see Bundled font), so it looks the same without installing it.

settings.label: Bundled font file
settings.description: A font file in the island's assets/fonts folder, loaded when the island starts so the text looks the same on every computer. Empty = only installed fonts.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Default text size. Titles and labels that need to stand out set their own size.

settings.label: Text weight
settings.description: Thickness of the text, from thin (100) to black (900). 400 is regular, 600 semibold.

settings.label: Text roundness
settings.description: How rounded the letters' ends are, from sharp (0) to fully round (100). Allo's own setting; a font without it ignores this.

settings.label: Optical sizes
settings.description: Small text gets the font's sturdier cut and big text its finer one, the way the font was drawn for each size (Allo's optical size). Off = one cut for every size.

settings.label: Smallest optical size
settings.description: Text smaller than this uses the cut drawn for this size.

settings.label: Largest optical size
settings.description: Text bigger than this uses the cut drawn for this size.

groups.title: Colors
groups.description: Accent colors. Panels pick from these depending on the situation.

settings.label: Main color
settings.description: White text and icons: the bar, the notch, and the dark mode's text.

settings.label: Charging
settings.description: Used for the battery while it charges.

settings.label: Power saver
settings.description: Used for the battery when the power saver mode is on.

settings.label: Balanced
settings.description: Battery color (idle icon and battery panel) in balanced power mode.

settings.label: Performance
settings.description: Battery color (idle icon and battery panel) in performance mode.

settings.label: Warning
settings.description: Used for problems, like a nearly empty battery (idle icon and battery panel).

settings.label: Secondary text
settings.description: Grey text in the bar and the notch (captions, values).

settings.label: Accent
settings.description: Blue used for Wi-Fi alerts and message icons. Used when "Follow the system accent" is off, or when the system has no accent color set.

settings.label: Follow the system accent
settings.description: Use the accent color chosen for the whole desktop (in the settings app, or GNOME's Appearance settings) instead of the one above. Changes show right away.

settings.label: System accent colors
settings.description: The color the island uses for each of the desktop's accent names (blue, teal, green, yellow, orange, red, pink, purple, slate). Brighter than GTK's own, to read well on the dark island.

settings.label: Light fill
settings.description: How light a solid badge's color must be for its icon to turn black instead of white (0-1, by luminance). White on blue and red; black on yellow, green and white.

settings.label: Notch (pill style)
settings.description: The pill-style notch's corners (island.style "pill"); at rest it's a pill anyway (at most half its height).

settings.label: Notch
settings.description: The notch's bottom corners when it opens (at rest it's a pill anyway).

settings.label: Notch's top curves
settings.description: The small inward curves joining the notch to the screen's edge.

settings.label: Pills
settings.description: Buttons, sliders, the search field, chips (100 = always a full pill).

settings.label: List highlights
settings.description: The highlight behind a selected row.

settings.label: Dropdowns and cards
settings.description: The dropdowns and the notification cards.

settings.label: Tiles
settings.description: Pictures, icons' tiles, the shelf's cards.

settings.label: Small things
settings.description: Keycaps, and the least any corner gets.

settings.label: Light or dark
settings.description: Whether the dropdowns and the notification cards are light or dark. System = follow the desktop's choice (the settings app's Appearance page). The bar's icons stay white and the notch stays black either way.

settings.label: Light: dropdowns
settings.description: The background of the dropdowns in light mode.

settings.label: Light: notification cards
settings.description: The background of the notification cards in light mode.

settings.label: Light: text
settings.description: Text in the dropdowns and on the cards in light mode.

settings.label: Light: grey text
settings.description: Captions, values and anything secondary in light mode.

settings.label: Light: charging green
settings.description: The charging green on a light background (the light one would be hard to read there).

settings.label: Light: power saver yellow
settings.description: The power saver yellow on a light background.

settings.label: Dark: dropdowns
settings.description: The background of the dropdowns in dark mode.

settings.label: Dark: notification cards
settings.description: The background of the notification cards in dark mode.

settings.label: Dark: text
settings.description: Text in the dropdowns and on the cards in dark mode.

settings.label: Dark: grey text
settings.description: Captions, values and anything secondary in dark mode.

settings.label: Dark: charging green
settings.description: The charging green on a dark background.

settings.label: Dark: power saver yellow
settings.description: The power saver yellow on a dark background.

settings.label: New notifications dot
settings.description: The small dot in the notch (and on the center's title) while some notifications are new.

settings.label: Shadows
settings.description: The color of the shadow under the notification cards.

settings.label: Light: edges
settings.description: The hairline around the dropdowns and the cards in light mode (at its opacity: panel.edgeOpacity, notifications.edgeOpacity).

settings.label: Dark: edges
settings.description: The same in dark mode.

groups.title: Screen corners
groups.description: Rounds the four corners of the screen, like a Mac display.

settings.label: Round screen corners
settings.description: Paints the four corners of every screen so the screen looks rounded. They stay on top of everything, including fullscreen apps, and clicks go through them.

settings.label: Corner size
settings.description: How rounded the screen corners are. Bigger values cut off more of the corners.

settings.label: Corner smoothness
settings.description: How gently the screen corners curve, like the island's corners (Island > Corner smoothness): the curve starts earlier and blends into the screen's edges. 0 = plain quarter circles.

settings.label: Corner color
settings.description: Color painted in the corners. Black blends in with the screen's bezel.

sections.title: Bar
sections.description: The bar across the top of the screen, like the macOS menu bar: the app and workspaces at the left, the status icons and the clock at the right. Its icons are always white.

settings.label: Bar height
settings.description: How tall the bar is. Windows start below it; it's a bit taller than the resting notch, so there's a little gap between the notch and the windows.

settings.label: Side margin
settings.description: Space between the screen's edges and the first and last things in the bar.

settings.label: Hide in fullscreen
settings.description: A fullscreen window (a video, a game) slides the bar away; the notch stays.

settings.label: Hiding speed
settings.description: How long the bar takes to slide away or come back.

settings.label: Show from the top edge
settings.description: While a fullscreen window hides the bar, resting the pointer on this many pixels at the very top of the screen brings it back, so its menus stay reachable. Clicks there no longer reach the fullscreen window. 0 = the bar stays hidden.

settings.label: Show after
settings.description: How long the pointer rests on the top edge before the bar comes back (so passing by doesn't bring it).

settings.label: Hide after
settings.description: Once the pointer has left the bar (and no dropdown of it is open), how long before it slides away again.

settings.label: Color
settings.description: The shade behind the bar, fading to nothing downwards, so the white icons read on any wallpaper.

settings.label: Strength
settings.description: How dark the shade is at the very top of the screen (it's lighter by the time it reaches the icons).

settings.label: Height
settings.description: How far down the shade reaches. It thins out along a curve, so most of this is a soft tail.

settings.label: Softness
settings.description: How the shade thins out: 1 = in a straight line (its end can show as a line), higher = it fades quickly at first, then gently into nothing.

settings.label: Highlight height
settings.description: The height of the pill that lights up behind an item under the pointer or while its dropdown is open.

settings.label: Item padding
settings.description: Space on each side of an item, inside its highlight.

settings.label: Highlight under the pointer
settings.description: How visible the highlight behind an item is under the pointer.

settings.label: Highlight while open
settings.description: How visible the highlight is while the item's dropdown is open.

settings.label: Logo
settings.description: Show your distribution's logo at the far left. Click it for a menu of places, the launcher and the session (lock, log out, restart, shut down).

settings.label: Logo size
settings.description: The size of the logo.

settings.label: Logos
settings.description: Which icon goes with which distribution (its ID in /etc/os-release).

settings.label: Other distributions
settings.description: The logo when the distribution isn't in the list.

settings.label: Menu
settings.description: The rows of the logo's menu.

settings.label: App name
settings.description: Show the name of the app you're in at the left of the bar. Click it for what to do with its window (fullscreen, maximize, float, close).

settings.label: App name weight
settings.description: How bold the app's name is.

settings.label: App menu
settings.description: The rows of the menu under the app's name: what to do with its window. Rows follow its state (Float becomes Tile while it floats, Maximize becomes Restore, Fullscreen becomes Exit fullscreen). (niri has no minimize.)

default.title: Maximize
command: niri msg action focus-window --id {id} && niri msg action maximize-column

default.title: Center
command: niri msg action focus-window --id {id} && niri msg action center-column

settings.label: Maximized from
settings.description: A window counts as maximized (its row says Restore) when its column takes at least this share of the screen's width.

settings.label: Workspaces
settings.description: Show this screen's workspaces as dots: the one you're on is a longer pill, the ones with windows brighter. Click a dot to go there, around them for niri's overview.

settings.label: Dot size
settings.description: The size of a workspace dot.

settings.label: Current workspace length
settings.description: How long the current workspace's pill is.

settings.label: Space between dots
settings.description: The space between two workspace dots.

settings.label: Workspaces with windows
settings.description: How visible the dot of a workspace with windows is.

settings.label: Empty workspaces
settings.description: How visible the dot of an empty workspace is.

settings.label: Pill motion
settings.description: How the current workspace's pill moves when you switch.

settings.label: Go-to command
settings.description: Run to go to a workspace; {idx} is its number on the screen.

settings.label: Overview command
settings.description: Run to open or close the overview.

settings.label: Date format
settings.description: How the date before the time is written (empty = no date). ddd = short weekday, d = day, MMM = short month.

settings.label: Time format (24 h)
settings.description: How the time is written on a 24-hour clock. HH = hours (00-23), mm = minutes, ss = seconds.

settings.label: Time format (12 h)
settings.description: How the time is written on a 12-hour clock. h = hours (1-12), mm = minutes, AP = AM / PM (left out by default, like on a phone). Which of the two formats shows is set in the time panel's "24-hour clock" settings.

settings.label: Date to time gap
settings.description: Space between the date and the time.

settings.label: Fixed-width digits
settings.description: Gives every digit the same width, so the island doesn't change size slightly each time the minute changes. Turn off for the font's natural, proportional digits.

settings.label: New notifications dot
settings.description: A small dot after the clock while some notifications are new (click the clock for the calendar and the notifications).

settings.label: Dot size
settings.description: Its size.

settings.label: Empty part opacity
settings.description: How visible the dim part of the level icons is (the Wi-Fi bars not reached, the battery past its level).

settings.label: Bluetooth icon size
settings.description: Size of the Bluetooth icon in the idle island.

settings.label: Bluetooth icon
settings.description: Icon shown in the idle island while a Bluetooth device is connected.

settings.label: Wi-Fi icon size
settings.description: Size of the Wi-Fi icon.

settings.label: Wi-Fi icons
settings.description: Icon files for 1, 2 and 3 bars, in assets/icons.

settings.label: Bluetooth
settings.description: Show the Bluetooth icon (with an adapter): bright while Bluetooth is on, dim while off. Click it for the Bluetooth dropdown.

settings.label: Wi-Fi
settings.description: Show the Wi-Fi icon: its bars while connected. Click it for the Wi-Fi dropdown.

settings.label: Wi-Fi off icon
settings.description: The icon while Wi-Fi is off.

settings.label: Battery
settings.description: Show the battery. Click it for the battery dropdown.

settings.label: Battery percentage
settings.description: Show the percentage next to the battery.

settings.label: Percentage gap
settings.description: Space between the percentage and the battery.

settings.label: Quick settings
settings.description: Show the quick settings icon (switches, volume, brightness).

settings.label: Quick settings icon
settings.description: The quick settings icon.

settings.label: Battery in color
settings.description: Draw the bar's battery (and its percentage) in the same color as the battery alerts: green while charging, yellow in power saver, red when low or in performance mode, white otherwise. Off: always white, like the other icons.

settings.label: Quick settings icon size
settings.description: The quick settings icon's size.

settings.label: Battery icon size
settings.description: Size of the battery icon (in the idle island and the charging alert).

settings.label: Battery icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons.

settings.label: Charging bolt
settings.description: While charging, a small bolt sits on the battery's right end, cut into it, and the battery keeps its usual color (white, or yellow with power saver) instead of turning green.

settings.label: Charging icon
settings.description: Icon cut into the battery while charging.

settings.label: Charging icon size
settings.description: Size of the charging bolt.

settings.label: Power saver plus
settings.description: While power saver is on (and not charging), a small plus sits on the battery's right end, cut into it.

settings.label: Power saver icon
settings.description: Icon cut into the battery while power saver is on.

settings.label: Power saver icon size
settings.description: Size of the power saver plus.

settings.label: Icon position
settings.description: Where the bolt or plus is centred, from the battery's right end (its little nub): negative = further in, over the body.

settings.label: Icon cut-out
settings.description: Empty space cut into the battery around the bolt or plus, so the two don't touch.

settings.label: Icon fade
settings.description: How long the bolt or plus takes to fade in or out.

settings.label: Icon bounce start
settings.description: Size the bolt or plus starts at before it bounces in.

settings.label: Icon bounce
settings.description: Spring of the bolt's or plus's bounce when it appears. Lower damping bounces more.

settings.label: Low battery warning
settings.description: Below this level (not charging), the battery counts as low: the dropdown's percentage turns red.

settings.label: Apps' icons
settings.description: Show the icons apps put in the tray (Discord, Steam, a VPN...). A click opens the app's menu under it (or does its main thing when it has none); a middle click does its main thing.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: The size of an app's tray icon.

settings.label: White icons
settings.description: Draw the apps' icons in white like the rest of the bar, instead of their own colors (an icon drawn on a filled background becomes a white square).

settings.label: Menu loading
settings.description: Shown in an app's tray menu until the app has sent it.

settings.label: Back
settings.description: The row that leaves a submenu.

settings.label: Back icon
settings.description: Its arrow.

settings.label: Submenu icon
settings.description: The arrow on a row that opens a submenu.

settings.label: Wait while heading in
settings.description: With a dropdown open, moving onto another bar item switches to its dropdown, except while the pointer heads down into the open one: then it waits this long, and switches only if the pointer stopped on the other item.

settings.label: Aiming room
settings.description: How much wider than the open dropdown the 'heading into it' zone is, on each side.

settings.label: Movement step
settings.description: The pointer's direction is measured over moves at least this long.

sections.title: Notch
sections.description: The black notch in the middle of the bar: what happens now (volume, alerts, the music playing) shows in it.

settings.label: Island color
settings.description: The notch's color. Black blends it into a dark screen edge like a real notch.

settings.label: Corner smoothness
settings.description: How gently the island's corners curve, like Apple's Dynamic Island. 0 = off: plain round corners, drawn more cheaply (good for older laptops). Higher = the curve starts earlier and blends into the straight edges. Pill-shaped islands stay plain half circles.

settings.label: Corner change
settings.description: How long the island's corners take to change when a pop-up rounds them differently (the screenshot rounds them more).

settings.label: Minimum width
settings.description: The notch is never narrower than this for a pop-up (the resting notch and the music have their own widths).

settings.label: Style
settings.description: Notch = glued to the top of the screen, joined to the edge by small inward curves, like a MacBook's notch. Pill = a separate rounded shape floating just below the edge, like the iPhone's Dynamic Island.

settings.label: Gap above the pill
settings.description: With the pill style: the space between the top of the screen and the pill.

settings.label: Width at rest
settings.description: How wide the notch is when nothing happens (small and calm; the music playing has its own size).

settings.label: Height at rest
settings.description: How tall the notch is when nothing happens. A bit shorter than the bar, so it never touches the windows.

settings.label: Pop-up height
settings.description: How tall the notch gets for a one-line pop-up (volume, brightness, alerts).

settings.label: Hold before shrinking
settings.description: When switching panels, how long the island keeps its size before shrinking. 0 (default) starts shrinking right away, which feels the most responsive; a small hold lets the old content visibly shrink first, but makes closing feel laggy.

settings.label: Switch window
settings.description: Size changes within this time after switching panels count as part of the switch (and get the hold before shrinking). Later changes, like search results updating, resize right away.

settings.label: Click outside to close
settings.description: A click anywhere outside an open dropdown, the notifications or the media controls closes them.

settings.label: Clicked panels take the keyboard
settings.description: A dropdown opened with the mouse takes the keyboard right away, so Escape closes it. Off = your app keeps the keyboard until you click in the dropdown.

settings.label: Key hold safety limit
settings.description: After Escape or Enter closes a panel, the island keeps the keyboard until you let go of the key, so the key isn't passed to the window behind (e.g. a fullscreen video). This is the longest it will wait.

settings.label: Priority order
settings.description: What wins when several things want the notch at once, most important first. Anything covered keeps its time and comes back afterwards. The default puts what you do before what the system does, and the music playing last (it's always there while music plays). Names: drop (something dragged over the notch), volume, brightness, microphone (the key you just pressed), headphones (you plugged them in), charging (you plugged the charger in), panel (the media controls you opened), lowBattery, wifiConnected, message, nowPlaying (music playing).

settings.label: Time left after hovering
settings.description: When the pointer leaves the notch or the notification cards, what was showing stays at least this long.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: How wide the notch gets while you drag something over it.

settings.label: Height
settings.description: How tall it gets.

settings.label: Outline inset
settings.description: How far the dashed outline sits inside the notch.

settings.label: Inside
settings.description: How visible the zone's inside is.

settings.label: Outline
settings.description: How visible the dashed outline is.

settings.label: Outline thickness
settings.description: How thick it is.

settings.label: Dash
settings.description: A dash's length (in line widths).

settings.label: Dash gap
settings.description: The gap between dashes (in line widths).

settings.label: Icon gap
settings.description: Space between the arrow and the words.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: The arrow.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Its size.

settings.label: Arrow motion
settings.description: How long the arrow takes to bob down and back.

settings.label: Arrow travel
settings.description: How far it bobs.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: The size of the words.

settings.label: Caption size
settings.description: The size of where it goes.

settings.label: Text
settings.description: What the zone says.

settings.label: Caption
settings.description: Under it; %1 = the shelf's folder.

settings.label: Leaving
settings.description: A drag must stay away from the notch this long before the drop zone closes (so passing over its edge doesn't flicker).

settings.label: Empty shelf
settings.description: How visible the drop zone is when it's the empty shelf (grey and still), not a drag over the notch.

settings.label: Space under the notch
settings.description: The space between the open notch and its tabs' pill.

settings.label: Arrival
settings.description: How far the pill comes down from as it appears.

settings.label: Height
settings.description: The height of the tabs' pill under the open notch (the player / the shelf, shown when both have something).

settings.label: Inset
settings.description: Space between the navbar's edge and the lit pill.

settings.label: Item width
settings.description: The width of a tab showing only its icon.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Its icons' size.

settings.label: Open one
settings.description: How visible the pill behind the open one is.

settings.label: Other icon
settings.description: How visible the other tab's icon is (full under the pointer).

settings.label: Player icon
settings.description: The player's icon.

settings.label: Shelf icon
settings.description: The shelf's icon.

settings.label: Shelf first after
settings.description: A click on the notch opens the shelf (not the player) for this long after something was put on it (a drop, a screenshot).

settings.label: Open tab padding
settings.description: Space at the open tab's ends (around its icon and name).

settings.label: Name gap
settings.description: Space between the open tab's icon and its name.

settings.label: Name size
settings.description: The size of the open tab's name.

settings.label: Music
settings.description: The player's tab name.

settings.label: Shelf
settings.description: The shelf's tab name.

settings.label: Switching
settings.description: How long the tabs take to change widths and the lit pill to move when you switch.

settings.label: Name fade
settings.description: How long the open tab's name takes to fade in (out: half as long).

settings.label: Name delay
settings.description: The new name waits this long, while its tab widens, before fading in.

sections.title: Animation
sections.description: How the notch, the dropdowns and their content move.

groups.title: Island springs
groups.description: The island moves on springs. Response is roughly the duration in seconds; damping 1 means no bounce, lower bounces more.

settings.label: Grow
settings.description: Spring used when the island gets bigger (wider and taller). Lower damping bounces more. niri's window-open animation mirrors it (~/.config/niri/config.kdl).

settings.label: Shrink
settings.description: Spring used when the island gets smaller, in both directions.

groups.title: Content transition
groups.description: How content swaps when you switch panels.

settings.label: Content fade in
settings.description: How long new content takes to fade in and come into focus.

settings.label: Opacity share of fade in
settings.description: How far through the fade in the content is fully opaque. The blur keeps clearing after that.

settings.label: Pop-up animations start
settings.description: How far through the fade in a pop-up's own little animation starts (the microphone's wiggle, the charging battery filling, the Wi-Fi bars lighting up, the headphones bouncing in). Starting earlier plays part of it while it's still faded or blurred. Fully opaque comes at "Opacity share of fade in"; most of the blur is gone by 75 %.

settings.label: Start fading in at
settings.description: How grown the island must be (compared to its final size) before new content starts to appear.

settings.label: Content fade out
settings.description: How long old content takes to fade out while the island changes. It fades fast at first and eases out, so closing reacts immediately.

settings.label: Overlap
settings.description: How visible the old content may still be when the new content starts. 0 = strictly one after the other.

settings.label: Shrink of old content
settings.description: Size the old content shrinks to while it fades out.

settings.label: Old content follows island
settings.description: How strongly old content shrinks with the island. 0 = keeps its size and gets cut off, 1 = always fits inside.

settings.label: Maximum stretch
settings.description: How much bigger than normal content may get when the island bounces past its size.

settings.label: Minimum appearing size
settings.description: The smallest a panel's content can look while it appears. Content follows the island as it grows; raising this makes it start bigger instead of growing from tiny (the island's edge crops it until there's room). 0 = always follow the island.

settings.label: Blur strength
settings.description: How blurry content gets while it fades. 0 turns the blur off.

settings.label: Maximum blur radius
settings.description: Blur radius at full strength.

settings.label: Fade out blur curve
settings.description: Below 1 the blur kicks in early when content leaves; 1 grows it evenly.

settings.label: Pop start size
settings.description: Size new content starts at before it bounces to full size when a panel opens.

settings.label: Pop spring
settings.description: Spring of the bounce when a panel opens. Only response and damping are used.

groups.title: Small animations
groups.description: Hover, press and color changes.

settings.label: Color change
settings.description: How long color changes take, e.g. the battery panel switching to green when charging.

settings.label: Hover fade
settings.description: How long hover highlights take to appear and disappear.

settings.label: Pressed size
settings.description: Size of a button while it is pressed.

settings.label: Press animation
settings.description: How long a button takes to shrink and grow back when pressed.

settings.label: Settle after opening
settings.description: Once a panel has opened, how long its content takes to stop following the island size.

sections.title: Pop-ups
sections.description: The shared look of everything that pops up in the notch (volume, microphone, alerts, messages), so they feel like one family.

settings.label: Edge padding
settings.description: Space between the island edge and text or glyphs at either end of a pop-up.

settings.label: Badge inset
settings.description: Space around a round badge sitting at the end of a pop-up (the microphone, the message icon). Keeps the badge following the curve of the island.

settings.label: Spacing
settings.description: Space between a glyph or badge and the text next to it.

settings.label: Two-line height
settings.description: Height of pop-ups that show two lines, like "Connected" above a device name. One-line pop-ups are as tall as the resting island.

settings.label: Title size
settings.description: Size of the main text in pop-ups (device name, "Low Battery", the message).

settings.label: Caption size
settings.description: Size of the small grey line above a title ("Connected").

settings.label: Line spacing
settings.description: Space between a caption and its title.

settings.label: Badge glyph size
settings.description: Size of the icon inside a round badge.

settings.label: Badge fill
settings.description: How visible the soft background of a badge is (0 = invisible, 1 = solid color).

settings.label: Badge fill on hover
settings.description: Badge background when the mouse is over a clickable badge.

groups.title: Badge with a word

settings.description: How visible a switch is when there's nothing to switch (no microphone, no Bluetooth).

settings.label: Off

settings.description: Under a switch that's on with nothing more to say (Wi-Fi not connected, Bluetooth with no device, the microphone).

settings.description: How long the badge takes to come back up from the press while it opens.

settings.description: How quickly the badge's icon and word fade as it opens (and the rows as it closes).

settings.label: Row stagger

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space between the media panel's edge and what's inside (its own: a bit more than the other panels).

settings.label: No cover icon
settings.description: Icon shown on a soft tile when the track has no cover.

settings.description: Size of that icon.

settings.description: Space between the title and the artist.

settings.description: Text size of the track's title.

settings.label: Title weight
settings.description: Thickness of the title (400 = regular, 600 = semibold).

settings.description: Text size of the artist, in grey under the title.

settings.label: Nothing playing
settings.description: Shown in grey instead of the title when no app is playing anything.

groups.title: Progress
groups.description: The bar with the time played at the left and the time left at the right. Drag or scroll it to move in the track.

settings.label: Space above
settings.description: Space between the cover and the progress bar.

settings.label: Space beside the times
settings.description: Space between each time and the bar.

settings.label: Time size
settings.description: Text size of the two times.

settings.label: Unknown time
settings.description: Shown in place of both times when the player doesn't say how long the track is or where it's at (YouTube Music in a browser often doesn't, live streams never do). The bar then stays empty and can't be dragged; the panel keeps its size.

settings.label: Scroll step
settings.description: How far one notch of the mouse wheel moves in the track.

settings.label: Scroll seek delay
settings.description: When scrolling on the bar, how long it waits after the last notch before moving the music (dragging moves it when you let go).

settings.label: Progress step
settings.description: How far the progress bar's fill moves at a time, in screen pixels. Smaller = smoother, at the cost of a few more redraws (0.5: about two a second on a 3-minute song).

settings.label: Fastest update
settings.description: The progress bar moves a small step at a time (Progress step), read from the player's position; on a very short track, at most this often.

groups.title: Controls
groups.description: Previous, play / pause and next, centred at the bottom.

settings.label: Space above
settings.description: Space between the progress bar and the controls.

settings.label: Previous / next size
settings.description: Size of the previous and next buttons.

settings.label: Play size
settings.description: Size of the play / pause button (a bit bigger, in the middle).

settings.label: Spacing
settings.description: Distance from the middle of play / pause to the middle of previous and next.

settings.label: Unavailable
settings.description: How visible a button is when the player can't do it (e.g. no next track).

settings.label: Play / pause swap size
settings.description: How small the glyph that goes away gets while play and pause swap.

settings.label: Play / pause swap
settings.description: How long play and pause take to swap.

settings.label: Skip push
settings.description: How long the previous / next button's little push takes when you skip: a new triangle grows in at the back while the front one is pushed out.

settings.label: Skip triangles gap
settings.description: How far apart the two triangles of the previous / next buttons are, as a share of the button's size.

settings.label: Play icon
settings.description: Icon of the play button.

settings.label: Pause icon
settings.description: Icon of the pause button.

settings.label: Skip icon
settings.description: One triangle of the previous / next buttons: drawn twice side by side (mirrored for previous), so skipping can push a new one in.

groups.title: Music bars
groups.description: The little bars at the top right that move with the music, in the cover's color (also in the idle island). They follow the real sound when the small program cava is installed (sudo dnf install cava); without it they dance on their own.

settings.label: Follow the music
settings.description: Make the bars follow what's actually playing (bass at the left, treble at the right). Needs cava installed; it runs only while music plays and the bars are on screen. Off: the bars dance on their own.

settings.label: Updates per second
settings.description: How many times a second the bars follow the sound (more = smoother, a bit more work for the computer).

settings.label: Smoothing
settings.description: How calm the bars are when following the music (higher = softer, slower moves; lower = twitchier).

settings.label: Glide
settings.description: Following the music, how long each bar takes to move to a new height. Longer = calmer, rounder moves; shorter = snappier.

settings.label: Keep listening
settings.description: Following the music: how long the listening keeps going after the last bars leave the screen, so it isn't restarted when the music alert hands over to the idle island.

settings.label: Lowest pitch
settings.description: The deepest sound the leftmost bar listens to.

settings.label: Highest pitch
settings.description: The highest sound the rightmost bar listens to.

settings.label: Bars
settings.description: How many bars.

settings.label: Bar width
settings.description: Width of each bar (round ends).

settings.label: Gap
settings.description: Space between the bars.

settings.label: Height
settings.description: Height of the bars at their tallest.

settings.label: Beat
settings.description: Without cava: how often the bars pick a new height (lower = busier).

settings.label: Lowest
settings.description: Without cava: how low a bar can go while playing (share of its full height).

settings.label: Paused height
settings.description: Height of the bars while paused or silent (share of the full height); following the music, they never go below it.

settings.label: Corner space
settings.description: In the media panel: extra space between the bars and the panel's top and right edges, on top of the padding.

groups.title: Cover color
groups.description: The bars take their color from the cover, like on the iPhone.

settings.label: Without a cover
settings.description: Color of the bars when the cover can't be read (no cover, or one on the internet: only covers saved on the computer are read).

settings.label: Least brightness
settings.description: The cover's color is made at least this bright, so it shows on black.

settings.label: Saturation boost
settings.description: Multiplies the cover color's saturation (1 = as is).

settings.label: Prefer colorful
settings.description: How much a colorful part of the cover is preferred over a bright grey one.

settings.label: Colors looked at
settings.description: The cover is boiled down to 2 to the power of this many colors before one is picked.

sections.title: Wallpaper picker

groups.title: Pictures

settings.label: Tidy names

groups.title: In the launcher
groups.description: How the wallpaper panel shows up in search.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Name in the search results.

settings.label: Subtitle
settings.description: Grey text next to the name.

settings.label: Keywords
settings.description: Other words that find it (space separated).

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon in the search results.

sections.title: Picture carousels
sections.description: The row of cards in the wallpaper and screenshots panels: the picked one in front, its neighbours turned behind it. Both panels have the launcher's width and padding (Search); the front card fills what the side cards leave. Corners follow the corner style (tiles).

settings.label: Card shape
settings.description: Width divided by height of every card. 0 = the same shape as your screen.

settings.label: Cards on each side
settings.description: How many pictures show behind the front one, on each side.

settings.label: Side card distance
settings.description: How far each card behind sits from the one before it. The panel is as wide as the launcher, so a bigger distance makes the front card smaller.

settings.label: Side card size
settings.description: Size of the cards behind, compared to the front one (each further card shrinks again).

settings.label: Side card turn
settings.description: How much the cards behind are turned, left ones one way, right ones the other.

settings.label: Side card darkening
settings.description: How much darker the cards behind are. 0 = as bright as the front one.

settings.label: Name position
settings.description: Where the picture's name sits: above the cards (like the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth panels' names) or under them.

settings.label: Name gap
settings.description: Space between the cards and the picture's name.

settings.label: File card padding
settings.description: Space inside a card that shows a file's icon and name.

settings.label: File card gap
settings.description: Space between the icon and the name.

settings.label: File icon size
settings.description: The largest a file's icon gets on its card.

settings.label: File icon share
settings.description: The icon is at most this share of the card's height.

settings.label: File name size
settings.description: The size of the name under it.

settings.label: Slide spring
settings.description: How the row slides to the next picture.

settings.label: End bump
settings.description: How far the row slides when you push past the first or last picture, in cards.

settings.label: End bump push
settings.description: How long the push past the end takes, before it springs back.

settings.label: End bump spring
settings.description: How the row springs back after a push past the end.

settings.label: Drag momentum
settings.description: How far a quick drag carries on after you let go (seconds of its speed). 0 = it stops where you let go.

settings.label: Drag past the ends
settings.description: How far you can drag past the first or last picture, in cards.

settings.label: Press
settings.description: How much the front card sinks when you use it (put a wallpaper on, copy a screenshot).

settings.label: Apply press time
settings.description: How long the card takes to sink before it springs back.

settings.label: Apply spring
settings.description: How the card springs back after sinking.

settings.label: Removing
settings.description: How long a card takes to shrink and fade when it's taken off the shelf.

settings.label: Removing: shrinks to
settings.description: How small a removed card gets as it fades.

groups.title: Standing out
groups.description: What sets the cards apart from the island, so a dark picture doesn't melt into it (no outline).

settings.label: Style
settings.description: glow: each picture's own colours, blurred, spread softly around its card (strongest on the front one). lift: a faint light under every card. none: nothing.

settings.label: Glow strength
settings.description: How visible the glow around the front card is.

settings.label: Glow behind
settings.description: How strong the glow of the cards behind the front one is, as a share of the front card's (0 = only the front card glows).

settings.label: Glow softness
settings.description: How far the picture is blurred for its glow.

settings.label: Glow size
settings.description: How far past the card the glow reaches.

settings.label: Glow brightness
settings.description: Brightens the glow, so even a dark picture lights up its surroundings a little.

settings.label: Glow colour
settings.description: How colourful the glow is (0 = the picture's colours, more = richer).

settings.label: Lift strength
settings.description: How bright the light under each card is.

settings.label: Lift softness
settings.description: How soft the light's edge is.

settings.label: Lift size
settings.description: How far the light reaches past the card before it fades.

settings.label: Tilt
settings.description: The card under the pointer tilts toward it, in 3D (the wallpaper picker, the shelf).

settings.label: Tilt angle
settings.description: How far it tilts at its edges.

settings.label: Tilt depth
settings.description: How close the eye seems to be: smaller = a stronger 3D effect when the card tilts.

settings.label: Tilt motion
settings.description: How the card follows the pointer and settles back flat.

settings.label: Shine
settings.description: A soft light follows the pointer across the card it's over (any card).

settings.label: Shine strength
settings.description: How bright that light is at its centre.

settings.label: Shine size
settings.description: How far the light reaches, as a share of the card's size.

settings.label: Shine softness
settings.description: How much light is left halfway out (lower = a softer, more diffuse spot).

settings.label: Shine fade
settings.description: How long the light takes to appear on a card and to go.

groups.title: Check badge
groups.description: The check on the wallpaper in use, or on the screenshot you just copied.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Glyph on the marked picture: the wallpaper in use, the screenshot you just copied.

settings.label: Badge size
settings.description: Size of the round badge.

settings.label: Glyph size
settings.description: Size of the check inside the badge.

settings.label: Badge inset
settings.description: Distance from the card's top right corner.

settings.label: Pop-in size
settings.description: Size the badge grows from when a wallpaper is put on.

settings.label: Pop-in spring
settings.description: How the badge pops in.

settings.label: Picture under the pointer
settings.description: Width of the small copy of the picture that follows the pointer while you drag a screenshot out of the island.

settings.label: Start delay
settings.description: Time between picking a picture up and the drag starting, so the invisible layer that closes panels on a click outside is gone first (otherwise it would catch the drop).

sections.title: Shelf
sections.description: What the notch holds: a folder of its own. Drop files on the notch to keep them there; every screenshot goes there too. Open it from the peek (rest the pointer on the notch).

groups.title: Behavior
groups.description: The pictures come from the screenshot folder (Screenshot pop-up > Folder).

settings.label: Folder
settings.description: The folder the notch holds things in. Files dropped on the notch are copied there; screenshots are linked there (no extra space).

settings.label: Keep screenshots
settings.description: Every screenshot you take goes on the shelf by itself.

settings.label: Opening closes it
settings.description: Opening a file (click, Enter) also closes the shelf.

settings.label: Remove command
settings.description: Run to take something off the shelf (the ×, Delete); {path} is the file. The default moves it to the trash.

settings.label: Close after showing in Files
settings.description: Showing a file in Files (Shift+Enter, right click) also closes the shelf.

settings.label: Drag out of the island
settings.description: Drag the front card up or down out of the notch to drop the file into another app (a mail, a chat, a folder).

settings.label: Nothing yet
settings.description: What the empty shelf says (it's the drop zone, muted).

settings.label: Copy command
settings.description: Run to copy a picture to the clipboard (Ctrl+C on a picture); {path} is the file.

groups.title: Cards

settings.label: Narrowest card
settings.description: A tall preview is cropped to at least this width / height.

settings.label: Widest card
settings.description: A wide preview is cropped to at most this width / height.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: How wide the shelf is.

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space around the cards.

settings.label: File card shape
settings.description: The width / height of a card without a picture (a text file: its icon and name).

settings.label: Remove icon

settings.label: Remove size

settings.label: Remove inset
settings.description: How far it sits from the card's corner.

settings.label: Remove glyph
settings.description: The size of the × itself.

settings.description: Glyph on the screenshot you just copied.

settings.description: Between the file's name and when it arrived.

sections.title: Search

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the search panel.

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space between the panel edge and its content.

settings.label: Field to results gap
settings.description: Space between the search field and the results.

settings.label: Field height
settings.description: Height of the search field.

settings.label: Field text size
settings.description: Text size of what you type.

settings.label: Placeholder

settings.label: Search icon

settings.label: Search icon size
settings.description: Size of the magnifier in front of the search field.

settings.label: Search icon gap
settings.description: Space between the magnifier and the text.

settings.label: Divider thickness
settings.description: Thickness of the thin line between the search field and the results.

settings.label: Divider visibility
settings.description: How visible the line between the search field and the results is.

settings.label: Number of results
settings.description: Most results listed for a search. Past "Visible rows before scrolling" the list scrolls.

settings.label: Visible rows before scrolling
settings.description: The results grow up to this many rows, then the list scrolls (mouse wheel, drag, or the arrow keys).

settings.label: Scroll edge fade
settings.description: Height of the fade at the top or bottom of the results when there are more to scroll to. 0 = no fade.

settings.label: Keyboard scroll speed
settings.description: How long the results take to scroll to the one picked with the arrow keys.

settings.label: Result height
settings.description: Height of each result row.

settings.label: Result padding
settings.description: Space around the name and description in a result.

settings.label: Result icon size
settings.description: Size of app icons in the results.

settings.label: Icon inset
settings.description: Space between the left edge of a result and its icon.

settings.label: Description size
settings.description: Text size of the app description on the right of a result.

settings.label: Text selection opacity
settings.description: Opacity of the highlight behind selected text in the field.

settings.label: Calculator symbol size
settings.description: Size of the "=" shown next to a calculation result, compared to the app icon size.

settings.label: Description width
settings.description: Widest the right-hand label (kind, "Open ↵") may get, as a share of the row width.

settings.label: Panel icon size
settings.description: Size of island panel icons in the results, compared to app icons.

settings.label: Section title height
settings.description: Height of the small grey titles above each group of results (Applications, Commands...).

settings.label: Name to subtitle gap
settings.description: Space between a result name and the grey text after it.

settings.label: Key height
settings.description: Height of the little key shown on the selected result ("↵").

settings.label: Key padding
settings.description: Space on each side of the key symbol.

settings.label: Key gap
settings.description: Space between "Open" and the key.

settings.label: Key background
settings.description: How visible the background of the little key is.

settings.label: Enter key symbol
settings.description: What the little key on the selected result shows.

groups.title: Pinned
groups.description: Pin panels, apps and commands (Ctrl+P or a right-click on a result): with nothing typed, the launcher shows them as tiles. Arrows move, Enter opens, Ctrl+Left / Right or dragging reorders, Ctrl+P or a right-click unpins.

settings.label: Tiles per row
settings.description: How many pinned tiles fit in a row of the launcher (shown when nothing is typed).

settings.label: Tile height
settings.description: Height of a pinned tile (its icon and name).

settings.label: Tile row gap
settings.description: Space between two rows of pinned tiles.

settings.label: Tile icon size
settings.description: Size of a pinned tile's icon.

settings.label: Tile padding
settings.description: Space above a tile's icon and on each side of its name.

settings.label: Tile name gap
settings.description: Space between a tile's icon and its name.

settings.label: Tile name size
settings.description: Text size of a tile's name.

settings.label: Drag start
settings.description: How far you press and move a pinned tile before it starts being dragged (less = a click).

settings.label: Dragged tile size
settings.description: A dragged tile grows a little to show it's lifted.

settings.label: Pin key
settings.description: With Ctrl, pins or unpins the selected result or tile (a right-click does too).

settings.label: Pinned mark
settings.description: Small icon shown on a result that's pinned.

settings.label: Pinned mark size
settings.description: Size of that small icon.

groups.title: Actions
groups.description: Commands you can run from the search, like opening the trash or powering off.

settings.label: Actions
settings.description: Each action has a title, a description, extra keywords, an icon and the command it runs. Actions marked "confirm" need Enter pressed twice, so a stray Enter can't reboot or power off.

default.title: Power Off
default.subtitle: Shut down the computer
default.keywords: shutdown shut down poweroff turn off

settings.label: Confirmation text
settings.description: Shown next to an action that is waiting for its second Enter.

settings.label: Shrink delay while typing
settings.description: How long typing must pause before the panel shrinks to fewer results. Growing is instant.

groups.title: Calculator
groups.description: Calculations typed in the search (12*4, 2^10): Enter copies the result.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: When calculations show up. always = a calculation comes first whenever what you type is one, and typing a prefix ("=") shows only it. prefix = only after typing a prefix. off = never.

settings.label: Prefixes
settings.description: What you type at the start of the search to show only the calculation (it turns into a pill), e.g. "=", "calc:".

settings.label: Pill label
settings.description: Name in the pill while calculating.

settings.label: Placeholder
settings.description: Hint shown in the search field while calculating.

settings.label: Pill icon
settings.description: Icon in the pill while calculating (file name in assets/icons).

groups.title: Settings search
groups.description: The desktop's settings (Wi-Fi, displays, the mouse...) found by name; Enter opens the Settings app on that page.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: When settings show up. always = among the other results, and typing a prefix ("s:") shows only settings. prefix = only after typing a prefix. off = never.

settings.label: Settings among other results
settings.description: How many settings show among the other results when settings are shown always. Typing a prefix shows them all.

settings.label: Prefixes
settings.description: What you type at the start of the search to search only settings (it turns into a pill), e.g. "s:", "settings:".

settings.label: Pill label
settings.description: Name in the pill while searching only settings.

settings.label: Placeholder
settings.description: Hint shown in the search field while searching only settings.

settings.label: Pill icon
settings.description: Icon in the pill while searching only settings (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Page icons
settings.description: Show each setting with its page's icon from the Settings app (a mouse for Mouse & Touchpad, a speaker for Sound). Off: the same gear for every setting.

settings.label: Result icon
settings.description: Icon of a setting in the results when it has no page icon (or page icons are off); file name in assets/icons.

settings.label: List command
settings.description: Command that prints every setting as JSON ([{page, pageLabel, title}]); run each time the search opens. Without it (the Settings app isn't installed), no settings show.

settings.label: Open command
settings.description: Command that opens the Settings app on a setting: {page} is replaced by its page's name, {title} by the setting's (Settings scrolls to it and highlights it).

groups.title: Web search
groups.description: What you type can also be searched on the web: the last result opens your browser on it. A web address (like rust-lang.org) opens that site instead.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: When the web search shows up. always = it's always the last result (Enter picks it when nothing else matches), and typing one of its prefixes shows only it. prefix = only after typing one of its prefixes ("w:", it turns into a pill). off = never.

settings.label: Prefixes
settings.description: What you type at the start of the search to search only the web (it turns into a pill), e.g. "w:", "web:".

settings.label: Pill label
settings.description: Name in the pill while searching only the web.

settings.label: Placeholder
settings.description: Hint shown in the search field while searching only the web.

settings.label: Pill icon
settings.description: Icon in the pill while searching only the web (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Search engine name
settings.description: Name shown in grey next to the web search result.

settings.label: Search address
settings.description: The search engine's address. {query} is replaced by what you typed. For DuckDuckGo: https://duckduckgo.com/?q={query}

settings.label: Open web addresses
settings.description: When what you typed looks like a web address (rust-lang.org, https://...), the last result opens that site instead of searching for it.

settings.label: Web icon
settings.description: Icon shown next to the web result (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Open command
settings.description: How the web page is opened. The default opens it in your usual browser. {url} is replaced by the address.

settings.label: Bring the browser forward
settings.description: After opening a web search or an address, switches to the browser's window, even if it's on another workspace. Without it, a browser that's already open loads the page in the background and it looks like nothing happened. Uses the same window commands as clicking a notification.

settings.label: Default browser command
settings.description: Prints the default browser's desktop file name (e.g. firefox.desktop), so the island knows which window to bring forward.

groups.title: File search
groups.description: Type a prefix such as "f:" to search your files and folders instead of apps. Enter opens the result, Shift+Enter shows it in the file manager.

settings.description: When files and folders show up. prefix = only after typing one of the prefixes ("f:", it turns into a pill), so the usual results stay short. always = the best matches among the other results too (search.files.mixedResults of them), and a prefix shows only files. off = never.

settings.label: Files among other results
settings.description: How many files and folders show among the other results when files are shown always. Typing a prefix shows them all.

settings.label: Pill label
settings.description: Text shown in the pill while searching files.

settings.label: Pill icon
settings.description: Icon in the pill while searching files (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Placeholder
settings.description: Hint shown in the search field while searching files.

settings.label: Search folder
settings.description: Folder whose contents are searched (including sub-folders). ~ is your home folder.

settings.label: Show hidden files
settings.description: Also search hidden files and folders (names starting with a dot, like .config).

settings.label: Skipped folders

settings.label: Maximum files

settings.label: Folder icon
settings.description: Icon shown next to folders (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Image icon

settings.label: File icon

settings.label: Image file types

settings.label: Show in folder command
settings.description: How Shift+Enter shows a file in the file manager. The default asks your file manager to open the folder with the file selected.
