settings.description: Text size of the volume number.

settings.label: Show volume changes
settings.description: Show the volume in the island when you press the volume keys. Off: the keys still change the volume, the island stays as it is.

settings.label: Step
settings.description: How much one key press or scroll notch changes the volume (0.05 = 5 %).

settings.label: Maximum volume
settings.description: Highest volume the keys and bar allow (1 = 100 %). Above 100 % shows in red.

settings.label: Unmute when changed
settings.description: Changing the volume turns the sound back on if it was muted.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the volume island stays after the last change.

sections.title: Brightness
sections.description: The brightness island (brightness keys).

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the brightness island (the same as the volume one by default, so the two pop-ups match).

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the sun icon.

settings.label: Sun icons
settings.description: Sun icons from dim to bright; the level is split evenly between them.

settings.label: Sun turn
settings.description: How far the sun turns between 0 % and 100 %.

settings.label: Show percentage
settings.description: Show the brightness percentage at the right of the bar.

settings.label: Number size
settings.description: Size of the brightness percentage.

settings.label: Show brightness changes
settings.description: Show the brightness in the island when you press the brightness keys. Off: the keys still change the brightness, the island stays as it is.

settings.label: Step
settings.description: How much one key press or scroll notch changes the brightness (0.05 = 5 %).

settings.label: Lowest brightness
settings.description: The keys and bar never go darker than this, so the screen never turns fully black (0.01 = 1 %).

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the brightness island stays after the last change.

settings.label: Backlight device
settings.description: Name of the screen backlight in /sys/class/backlight. Empty = the first one found.

sections.title: Microphone
sections.description: The island shown when the microphone is muted or turned back on.

settings.label: Show microphone mute
settings.description: Show the microphone state in the island when you press the mute key. Off: the key still mutes, the island stays as it is.

settings.label: Live icon
settings.description: Microphone icon while it's on.

settings.label: Muted icon
settings.description: Microphone icon while it's muted.

settings.label: Live text
settings.description: Text shown when the microphone is turned on.

settings.label: Muted text
settings.description: Text shown when the microphone is muted.

settings.label: Shake
settings.description: How far the badge tilts when it shakes on mute.

settings.label: Shake length
settings.description: How long the mute shake lasts.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the microphone island stays.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the microphone pop-up. The capsule sits at the left end and the state at the right end.

settings.label: Capsule width
settings.description: Width of the capsule holding the microphone at the left end.

sections.title: Messages
sections.description: Short messages sent by scripts (qs ipc call osd message "text" "icon.svg").

settings.label: Show messages
settings.description: Show messages that scripts send to the island (qs ipc call osd message).

settings.label: Maximum width
settings.description: Longer messages are cut with an ellipsis.

settings.label: Default icon
settings.description: Icon used when the message doesn't name one.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long a message stays.

sections.title: Low battery alert
sections.description: The warning shown in the island when the battery runs low.

settings.label: Show the alert
settings.description: Warn in the island when the battery runs low.

settings.label: Warn at
settings.description: Battery levels that trigger the warning, once each while on battery (e.g. 15 % then again at 5 %). Plugging in resets them.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the warning stays. 0 = until you click it.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the warning.

settings.label: Battery size
settings.description: Size of the red battery.

settings.label: Battery icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons.

settings.label: Percent to battery gap
settings.description: Space between the percentage and the battery icon at the right end.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Title of the warning.

settings.label: Power saver icon
settings.description: Icon of the power saver badge at the left end. Click it to turn power saver on.

settings.label: Pulse speed
settings.description: How long one slow pulse of the battery takes.

settings.label: Pulse depth
settings.description: How faint the battery gets at the bottom of a pulse. 1 = no pulse.

sections.title: Charging alert
sections.description: The alert that pops up when you plug the charger in.

settings.label: Show when plugged in
settings.description: Pop up in the island when the charger is plugged in.

settings.label: How long it stays
settings.description: How long the charging alert stays up.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the charging alert.

settings.label: Percent to battery gap
settings.description: Space between the percentage and the battery (the battery is the idle island's, same size).

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Text while charging.

settings.label: Full text
settings.description: Text when the battery is already full.

settings.label: Battery fill duration
settings.description: How long the battery takes to fill up to the level when the alert appears.

settings.label: Bolt
settings.description: Once the battery has filled up to its level, the charging bolt pops in on its right end, like in the idle island (same look: idle.battery.badge).

sections.title: Wi-Fi connected alert
sections.description: Shown in the island when you join a Wi-Fi network.

settings.label: Show the alert
settings.description: Show the network name in the island when you connect to Wi-Fi.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the alert stays.

settings.label: Maximum width
settings.description: Longer network names are cut with an ellipsis.

settings.label: Minimum width
settings.description: The alert is never narrower than this, even for a short network name.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the Wi-Fi icon.

settings.label: Status text
settings.description: Shown under the network name.

settings.label: Bar delay
settings.description: The Wi-Fi bars light up one after the other: time between two bars.

settings.label: Bar fade
settings.description: How long each bar takes to light up.

sections.title: Headphones alert
sections.description: Shown in the island when headphones (Bluetooth, USB or a jack) become the sound output.

settings.label: Show the alert
settings.description: Show the device name in the island when headphones connect.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the alert stays.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the headphones icon.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons.

settings.label: Status text
settings.description: Shown in green on the right.

settings.label: Minimum width
settings.description: The alert is never narrower than this, even for a short device name.

settings.label: Maximum width
settings.description: Long device names are cut with "…" past this width.

settings.label: Icon bounce start
settings.description: Size the icon starts at before it bounces in.

settings.label: Icon bounce
settings.description: Spring of the icon's bounce. Lower damping bounces more.

sections.title: Music in the notch
sections.description: While music plays, the notch shows it: the cover at the left, the bars at the right. Alerts cover it, then it comes back. Click it for the media controls.

settings.label: Show the alert
settings.description: Show the music playing in the notch.

settings.label: Stays after a pause
settings.description: After a pause, the music stays in the notch this long (a click on it opens the controls to start it again).

settings.label: Hide while you're in the player
settings.description: While the window playing the music is in front, the notch doesn't show it (you're looking at it); it comes back when you leave. In a browser, only while the tab in front is the one playing: its title holds the track, or it's a music site (Music sites).

settings.label: Browsers
settings.description: Apps treated as browsers (part of their name is enough): for them, the playing tab must be in front too.

settings.label: Music sites
settings.description: In a browser, a tab whose title holds one of these counts as the one playing the music.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: How wide the notch is while music plays (its cover at the left, its bars at the right).

settings.label: Height
settings.description: How tall it is while music plays.

settings.label: Space around the cover
settings.description: Space between the cover and the notch's edges.

settings.label: Bars
settings.description: How many bars.

settings.label: Bar height
settings.description: Height of the bars at their tallest.

settings.label: Note size
settings.description: Without a cover: size of the music note on its tile (share of the tile).

settings.label: Bars' margin
settings.description: Space between the bars and the notch's right end.

settings.label: Cover bounce start
settings.description: Size the cover starts at before it bounces in.

settings.label: Cover bounce
settings.description: Spring of the cover's bounce. Lower damping bounces more.

sections.title: Notifications
sections.description: Notifications slide in from the right as cards at the top right of the screen, like macOS, and are kept in the notification center (click the clock: under the calendar), across restarts.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: How wide the notification cards are (macOS: 344).

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space between a card's edges and its content.

settings.label: Spacing
settings.description: Space between a card's icon, its text and its picture.

settings.label: Line spacing
settings.description: Space between the lines of a notification.

settings.label: Picture size
settings.description: The size of the app's icon at a card's left.

settings.label: Space between cards
settings.description: The space between two cards.

settings.label: Space under the notch
settings.description: The space between the notch and the first card.

settings.label: Screen margin
settings.description: The cards sit this far from the screen's right edge.

settings.label: Picture size
settings.description: The size of a notification's picture at the card's right.

settings.label: Icon tile glyph
settings.description: With no app icon (or an urgent one): the glyph is this share of its tile.

settings.label: No app icon
settings.description: The glyph when the app has no icon.

settings.label: Urgent
settings.description: The glyph of an urgent notification (in red).

settings.label: Screenshot
settings.description: The glyph of a screenshot card.

settings.label: Edge
settings.description: The hairline around a card (0 = none).

settings.label: Edge strength
settings.description: How visible it is.

settings.label: Show the app's name
settings.description: Write the app's name above the title on each card.

settings.label: Title size
settings.description: Text size of the notification's title, in white.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Text size of the message, in grey under the title.

settings.label: Text weight
settings.description: How bold the message text is (400 = regular, 700 = bold).

settings.label: Lines when open
settings.description: Under the pointer, the message shows this many lines at most.

settings.label: Time size
settings.description: The size of when it came, at the top right of a card.

settings.label: Message lines
settings.description: The message shows this many lines until you point at it.

settings.label: App name size
settings.description: The size of the app's name above the title (with Show the app's name).

settings.label: Title weight
settings.description: How bold the title is.

settings.label: Just now
settings.description: When it came less than a minute ago.

settings.label: Minutes ago
settings.description: %1 = how many minutes.

settings.label: Hours ago
settings.description: %1 = how many hours.

settings.label: Older
settings.description: A day or more ago: the date. dd = day, MM = month.

settings.label: Buttons
settings.description: Most buttons shown for one notification.

settings.label: Button height
settings.description: Height of the notification's buttons.

settings.label: Button padding
settings.description: Space on each side of a button's text.

settings.label: Button spacing
settings.description: Space between buttons.

settings.label: Space above buttons
settings.description: Space between the text and the buttons.

settings.label: Button tint
settings.description: How visible the buttons and close button are.

settings.label: Button hover tint
settings.description: How visible a button is under the mouse.

settings.label: Close button size
settings.description: Size of the round close button.

settings.label: Close icon size
settings.description: Size of the cross inside the close button.

settings.label: Close icon
settings.description: Icon of the close button.

settings.label: × outline
settings.description: The thin outline around the × that shows on a card under the pointer.

settings.label: Show notifications
settings.description: Show notifications. Off: apps still send them, nothing shows.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long a card stays on screen when the app doesn't say (it stays in the center).

settings.label: Use the app's time
settings.description: Apps can ask for their notification to stay a given time; follow it.

settings.label: Urgent ones stay for
settings.description: How long an urgent card stays on screen (0 = until you close it).

settings.label: Show low-priority
settings.description: Low-urgency notifications drop in too. Off: they go quietly to the center.

settings.label: Open on hover
settings.description: Pointing at a card shows its whole message and its buttons.

settings.label: Click closes it
settings.description: Clicking a card also removes it from the center.

settings.label: Urgent ones break through Focus
settings.description: During Focus, urgent notifications still drop in (the rest go quietly to the center).

settings.label: Cards on screen
settings.description: At most this many cards show at once; older ones go to the center.

settings.label: History length
settings.description: The center keeps this many notifications at most (the oldest go).

settings.label: Swipe distance
settings.description: How far a card must go (or would go, thrown) to be sent away: right deletes it (out of the history too), up takes it off the screen (it stays in the history).

settings.label: Throw carry
settings.description: A card let go while moving keeps going for this long, in thought: if that would carry it past the swipe distance, it goes. Higher = a light flick is enough.

settings.label: Throw measured over
settings.description: How much of the end of a swipe its speed is measured on. A card held still this long before letting go isn't thrown.

settings.label: Pulled back
settings.description: A card moving back toward its place at least this fast when let go stays, even past the swipe distance.

settings.label: Swipe smoothing
settings.description: How closely a card follows your finger while you swipe it: it glides to where your finger put it in about this long, once per frame, so it moves smoothly instead of in steps. 0 = glued to the finger.

settings.label: Fastest exit
settings.description: A thrown card leaves at the speed you threw it, but never in less than this.

settings.label: Swipe direction
settings.description: After moving this far, a drag sticks to the way it started (right or up).

settings.label: Swipe spring
settings.description: How a card springs back when not dragged far enough.

settings.label: Swipe with a mouse wheel
settings.description: One notch of a mouse wheel this big sends a card away: sideways deletes it, up takes a card on screen off the screen. (A touchpad's two fingers move the card instead, like dragging it.)

settings.label: Touchpad swipe end
settings.description: For scrolling that never says when it ends (some smooth mouse wheels): how long without movement ends a swipe. (A touchpad says when your fingers lift.)

settings.label: Lost swipe end
settings.description: If a touchpad swipe's end never arrives, the card decides after this long without movement (no throw: it goes only if it's past the swipe distance).

groups.title: Clicking a notification
groups.description: Where a click takes you: the notification's own action, then the window that sent it.

settings.label: Bring up its window
settings.description: Clicking a notification brings the window that sent it to the front: the app's window, or the terminal a command sent it from.

settings.label: Open the app if it's closed
settings.description: When the app that sent a notification has no window open (and the notification can't open anything itself), clicking it starts the app.

settings.label: System ones open Settings
settings.description: Clicking a notification from the system (network, Bluetooth, printers, power, sound, updates) opens the matching page of the Settings app.

settings.label: System senders
settings.description: Which senders count as the system, and the Settings page each one opens: the sender's name in lower case with only letters and digits ("NetworkManager" -> "networkmanager") and the page's name.

settings.label: Parent processes followed
settings.description: How far up from the process that sent a notification to look for a window (a command run in a terminal: the command, its shell, the terminal).

settings.label: Windows command
settings.description: Command that lists the open windows as JSON (id, app id, process id, last focus).

settings.label: Focus command
settings.description: Command that brings a window to the front: {id} is replaced by the window's id.

settings.label: Arrival
settings.description: How a card slides in from the right, and how the others make room.

settings.label: Leaving
settings.description: How long a card takes to slide out to the right.

settings.label: Making room
settings.description: How long the other cards take to glide into place when one comes or goes.

settings.label: Opening on hover
settings.description: How long a card takes to grow to its whole message (and shrink back) under the pointer.

settings.label: Shadow softness
settings.description: How soft the shadow under a card is.

settings.label: Shadow drop
settings.description: How far down the shadow falls.

settings.label: Shadow strength
settings.description: How dark the shadow is.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: The title on the center's pill (under the calendar: click the clock).

settings.label: Clear all
settings.description: The button that empties the center.

settings.label: Nothing here
settings.description: Shown when there are no notifications.

settings.label: New
settings.description: The chip above what arrived since the center was last closed.

settings.label: Old
settings.description: The chip above the rest.

settings.label: Pill height
settings.description: The height of the center's header chips.

settings.label: Pill text size
settings.description: The size of the pill's title and count.

settings.label: Clear all cascade
settings.description: Clear all sends the cards out one after the other, this long apart (0 = all at once).

settings.label: Chip height
settings.description: The height of the NEW / OLD chips.

settings.label: Chip padding
settings.description: Space inside a chip at its ends (the header's and NEW / OLD).

settings.label: Chip background
settings.description: How visible a chip's background is.

settings.label: Chip text size
settings.description: The size of a chip's word.

settings.label: Chip letter spacing
settings.description: Extra space between a chip's letters.

settings.label: Opening
settings.description: How long the center takes to appear or go.

settings.label: Drop
settings.description: How far the center slides down as it appears.

settings.label: Edge room
settings.description: Room around the cards for their shadows and ×.

settings.label: Space under the calendar
settings.description: The center hangs under the calendar's card, this far below it.

settings.label: Space at the bottom
settings.description: The center stops this far above the bottom of the screen (then it scrolls).

sections.title: Screenshot card
sections.description: When you take a screenshot, a card with the picture drops in. Taking more piles them on the same card. Click it for the screenshots picker.

settings.label: Show screenshots
settings.description: Show the screenshot you just took in the island (click to open it in your image viewer). Off: the usual "Screenshot captured" notification.

settings.label: Shown for
settings.description: How long the screenshot card stays on screen.

settings.label: Screenshot notifications
settings.description: The titles of the notifications that announce a screenshot (niri says "Screenshot captured").

settings.label: Screenshots folder
settings.description: Where your screenshots are saved: the screenshots panel lists this folder, and the pop-up looks there for the picture when the notification doesn't say which file it is (the newest file saved just now).

settings.label: Just now
settings.description: How recent a file in the screenshots folder must be to count as the screenshot just taken.

groups.title: Layout
groups.description: The picture keeps the screenshot's proportions, as a card with small corners held in a lot of island.

settings.label: Picture roundness
settings.description: How round the pictures' corners are, as a share of their height.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: The card's title.

settings.label: Count
settings.description: Under the title with several pictures; %1 = how many.

settings.label: Pictures kept
settings.description: The card remembers this many screenshots at most.

settings.label: Picture height
settings.description: The height of the pictures on the card.

settings.label: Narrowest
settings.description: A tall screenshot is cropped to at least this width / height.

settings.label: Widest
settings.description: A wide screenshot is cropped to at most this width / height.

settings.label: Pictures shown
settings.description: How many pictures of the pile show.

settings.label: Offset
settings.description: How far each picture behind sticks out to the left.

settings.label: Tilt
settings.description: How much the pictures behind are turned, alternately left and right.

settings.label: Shrink
settings.description: How much smaller each picture behind is.

settings.label: Darken
settings.description: How much darker each picture behind is.

settings.label: Border
settings.description: A thin border in the card's color around each picture, so they stand apart.

sections.title: Goodbye
sections.description: When the computer powers off or restarts, the island writes "bye bye" by hand before the screen goes dark.

settings.label: Say goodbye
settings.description: Write "bye bye" in the island when the computer powers off or restarts, however it was started (the launcher, the power button, a command). The computer waits for it, a few seconds at most. Off = it goes down right away.

settings.label: Wait before writing
settings.description: Time for the island to take its shape (and the launcher to close) before the writing starts.

settings.label: Writing time
settings.description: How long writing "bye bye" takes. Keep the waiting, the writing and the pause under 5 seconds: after that the computer powers off anyway.

settings.label: Pause after writing
settings.description: How long "bye bye" stays once written, before the computer goes down.

settings.label: Longest wait
settings.description: The computer never waits longer than this for the goodbye, even if something goes wrong. The system itself stops waiting after 5 seconds (logind's InhibitDelayMaxSec).

settings.label: Handwriting
settings.description: The drawing that's written, from assets/handwriting. Its lines are drawn in order, like a pen.

settings.label: Writing height
settings.description: Height of the handwriting, from the top of the tallest letter to the bottom of the lowest one. Its width follows.

settings.label: Line thickness
settings.description: Thickness of the handwritten line.

settings.label: Side space
settings.description: Space between the handwriting and the island's left and right edges.

settings.label: Top and bottom space
settings.description: Space between the handwriting and the island's top and bottom edges.

sections.title: Sounds
sections.description: Short, soft sounds for what's worth hearing when you're not looking: notifications and alerts. Never for clicks, panels or the music controls. Silent while Focus is on (low battery excepted) and when the sound is muted.

settings.label: Sounds
settings.description: Play the island's sounds at all. Off = it stays silent.

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the island's sounds are, on top of the system volume.

settings.label: Quiet during Focus
settings.description: No sounds while Focus (do not disturb) is on, except the low battery warning.

settings.label: Minimum gap
settings.description: A sound right after another is skipped (several notifications at once make one sound).

settings.label: Notifications
settings.description: Play a short sound when a notification arrives.

settings.label: Notifications sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when a notification arrives.

settings.label: Low battery
settings.description: Play a short sound when the battery runs low.

settings.label: Low battery sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when the battery runs low.

settings.label: Charging
settings.description: Play a short sound when the charger is plugged in.

settings.label: Charging sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when the charger is plugged in.

settings.label: Headphones
settings.description: Play a short sound when headphones or a speaker connect.

settings.label: Headphones sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when headphones or a speaker connect.

settings.label: Wi-Fi connected
settings.description: Play a short sound when the computer joins a Wi-Fi network.

settings.label: Wi-Fi connected sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when the computer joins a Wi-Fi network.

sections.title: System
sections.description: How the shell listens to the system. You normally never need to change these.

settings.label: Audio check delay
settings.description: After an audio change (plugging headphones, a Bluetooth headset connecting), wait this long for things to settle before checking which output is in use. Several events usually arrive at once; this checks once for all of them.

settings.label: Event listener restart delay
settings.description: If a system event listener stops (for example the audio server restarted), wait this long before starting it again.

settings.label: Quiet start
settings.description: Right after the shell starts, Wi-Fi and headphones that are already connected don't pop up as new connections. This is how long that lasts.

settings.label: Save delay
settings.description: Saved state (the launcher's pins) is written this long after it last changed, so dragging a tile around doesn't write the file at every step.
